notes: Access: direct HTTP (curl_cffi, multiple attempts) and headless/headful Playwright both blocked by Cloudflare Turnstile ('Just a moment...' challenge, no r.jina.ai/translate.goog/webcache substitutes used per brief). Claude-in-Chrome (real logged Chrome session) passed the Turnstile challenge after a short wait and was used for the whole investigation. robots.txt itself is Cloudflare-challenged, but the prior Home-Decor pass's notes (via Wayback snapshot) confirmed no Claude-specific disallow exists on this zone. Checked: full mega-menu (all 9 top-level nav branches expanded to their leaf sub-categories, ~280 nodes), footer nav, and the site's own HTML sitemap (https://www.tavolashop.com/ae-en/sitemap.html, which explicitly enumerates every named category including niche ones like 'Clearance', 'Flash Sale', 'Bundle Offers', 'New Arrivals') -- no Bestsellers / Best Sellers / Top Sellers / Top Selling Products / Most Popular / Customer Favorites / Trending category exists anywhere in the taxonomy. Direct URL guesses /best-sellers, /bestsellers, /deals/best-sellers all returned 404. The homepage 'Explore' carousel has two themed tiles literally labelled 'Top Selling Knives' and 'Top Selling Homeware', but both resolve to plain ordinary category pages (href='knives' and href='table-home/homeware' respectively) with no bestseller-specific filtering, badge, or framing on the page itself -- excluded per brief section 3 (a banner that merely mentions bestselling products, not a bestseller merchandising PLP in its own right). Site search for 'best sellers' (catalogsearch/result/?q=best+sellers) returns 14 fuzzy text-match results (Peugeot mills, a salad spinner, a corkscrew) with no bestseller framing -- a generic search-results page, excluded per brief. No genuine Bestsellers PLP exists on this site.
